translationRepairs: On the first day of the fifth month, dingchou, the former Tang chancellors Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were made vice directors of the Secretariat, and Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju became vice director of the Chancellery; all held the rank of co-equal grand councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

On the first day of the fifth month, dingchou, the former Tang chancellors Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were made vice directors of the Chancellery (Menxia), and Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju became vice director of the Secretariat (Zhongshu); all held the rank of co-equal grand councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
Focus unit assigns 門下侍郎 to 張文蔚 and 楊涉 and 中書侍郎 to 薛貽矩; the prior idiomatic English swaps Secretariat and Chancellery. The proposed swap restores the offices and remains grammatical.

On the first day of the fifth month, dingchou, the Tang chancellors Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were made vice directors of the Secretariat, and Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju vice director of the Chancellery; all were co-equal managers of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.

On the first day of the fifth month, dingchou, the Tang chancellors Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were made vice directors of the Chancellery, and Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju vice director of the Secretariat; all were co-equal managers of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.
The literal field has the same office reversal as the idiomatic: Chinese 門下侍郎 goes to Zhang and Yang, 中書侍郎 to Xue. The proposed wording corrects that without other changes.
his great-grandfather An received the posthumous name Xuan Yuan and temple name Ancestor Su, and his great-grandmother of the Fan clan the name Xuanxi;
his high ancestor (gaozu) An received the posthumous name Xuan Yuan and temple name Ancestor Su, and his high ancestress of the Fan clan the name Xuanxi;

The focus unit has 皇高祖黯, and the next units are 曾祖茂琳, 祖信, and 考诚: 高祖 is the generation above 曾祖, so English “great-grandfather” understates the kinship. “High ancestor (gaozu)” correctly marks that generation.
his grandfather Maolin the name Guang Xian and temple name Ancestor Jing, and his grandmother of the Yang clan the name Guang Xiao;
his great-grandfather Maolin the name Guang Xian and temple name Ancestor Jing, and his great-grandmother of the Yang clan the name Guang Xiao;
Focus unit 曾祖茂琳 is great-grandfather in the 高祖–曾祖–祖–考 sequence; idiomatic “grandfather” collapses him with 祖信 in the next sentence. The proposed “great-grandfather/great-grandmother” matches 曾祖.
his grandfather Maolin the title Guang Xian and temple name Jingzu, and his grandmother the Yang clan the title Guang Xiao;
his great-grandfather Maolin the title Guang Xian and temple name Jingzu, and his great-grandmother the Yang clan the title Guang Xiao;
Literal English likewise renders 曾祖 as grandfather. Changing to great-grandfather/great-grandmother corrects the generation without altering titles or names.

Yu Jing, vice minister of Personnel, became vice director of the Chancellery, and Zhang Ce, Hanlin academician-in-attendance and vice minister of Rites, became vice minister of Justice; both held the rank of co-equal grand councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

Yu Jing, vice minister of Personnel, became vice director of the Secretariat (Zhongshu shilang), and Zhang Ce, Hanlin academician-in-attendance and vice minister of Rites, became vice minister of Justice; both held the rank of co-equal grand councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
Focus unit states 于兢為中書侍郎: Zhongshu is the Secretariat, not the Chancellery. The proposed idiomatic wording correctly names that office while leaving Zhang Ce’s appointment unchanged.
